inputs.name: hand over from Logging and Observability to Production Drift Monitoring

output.level_0: Production drift monitoring ignores logging data entirely, causing blind spots in anomaly detection.
output.level_1: No data flows from logging to drift monitoring, leaving production behavior untracked.
output.level_2: Engineers manually export logs to check for drift, a slow and error prone process.
output.level_3: Logs stream automatically into drift monitoring, triggering alerts on distribution shifts instantly.
output.level_4: Governed pipelines ensure log data integrity before feeding drift models, with full audit trails.
